n: 3.5 cu.ft Long Vent Electric Stacked Laundry Center 9 Wash cycles and AutoDry™
desc: Ideal for apartment or condominium living, an electric stacked washer and dryer combination with a long vent offers great washing and drying performance even when installation requires a long vent system. The washer with fabric softener dispenser releases fabric softener at just the right time and the dryer automatically senses when clothes are ready and stops the cycle.
hl: Keep your washer looking good thanks to the durable finish that resists scratches, chemicals and rust.
Help prevent overdrying with the AutoDry™ drying system that senses when clothes have reached the right moisture content and stops the cycle.
Choose the right setting for each load when you dry with Normal, Delicate, Air Only or Timed Dry cycles.
Dual action Agitator with Fabric Softener Dispenser
Get dual action cleaning and convenient fabric softener dispensing at just the right time when you fill this cap with softener before the cycle begins.
Get the space you need to easily wash everyday loads with a 3.5 cu. ft. capacity washer.
Get the space you need to easily dry everyday loads with a 5.9 cu. ft. capacity dryer.
